verdict: Sales rose 9% with every region growing and Asia up 28%, and profit jumped 43% as full-price selling lifted margins — so the company raised its full-year outlook.

takeaways.title: Revenue rose to $2.19B
takeaways.text: Net revenues rose 9% to $2.19B, with growth in every region, led by Asia at +28%.

takeaways.title: Gross margin widened sharply
takeaways.text: Gross profit was $1.63B on $2.19B of sales — a 74.2% gross margin, up from 67.9% a year earlier — helped by strong full-price demand and lower product costs this quarter.

takeaways.title: Net income jumped 43%
takeaways.text: Net income rose to $297M from $208M a year earlier, and the company raised its fiscal 2027 revenue and operating margin outlook.

oneTimers: Restructuring and other charges were $63M in the quarter, shown as their own operating expense line. Adjusted EPS of $4.64 excludes restructuring-related and other net benefits.
footerNote: Other income of $6M is interest income ($12M) and other income ($7M) minus interest expense ($13M), rounded to whole millions (exact net: $5.5M). Fiscal year ends in late March, so the quarter ended September 26, 2026 is the second quarter of fiscal 2027.
